featured_reviews.name: RITA LOBO
featured_reviews.review_text:
I have grown with this church..Since a little girl enjoying Masses in konkani and English...Even now when I don't belong to this parish ..I love visiting this church..it gives me immense pleasure and peace to attend first Friday services with blessed sacrament,mother of perpetual succour novenas on Wednesday...They have best flexibility in mass timing for everyone...All the priests here are so warm, friendly, genuine, supporting, welcoming,caring and they are always reinventing themselves..As a church there are so many activities from children,to youth to women to senior citizens...My deceased family members are laid in rest in the graveyard here..So for me it's the best place to visit ..the church the cementry overall very clean..lots of greenery around .. peaceful atmosphere..one gets from their busy work life balance..I remember when I was a child Fr Jerry used to conduct best konkani mass at DIVINE CHILD SCHOOL GROUND..This church has been blessed with lot of best charismatic priests like FR Jude@Fr Vincent @FR Errol@FR Swamy etc ....we will never forget their contribution in our lives in the past....The legacy still alive where konkani is also given priority like English ..well done to all the priests of Holy family Church...FR Gerard@FR Ceasar@FR Andrew@FR Sumit@FR Joaquim@FR Robin.@ FR Dean ( new addition to our parish)Awesome 👍 👏 Bravo 👏👏 well done' to you all,please continue doing the great job..we are always proud of you..

This lent 2026 they have invited Fr Velooran & friends from DIVINE RETREAT POTTA..

A 4 will find it very very difficult to get there as a lot of bikes are parked around the shops and the road is too narrow to pass through. The church has a good open area around it. In case you plan to get your 4wheeler your best bet is to park on Behrum Baug road.
